strengths: Correctly identified the dominant cell-cycle/mitotic program from top DEGs (MKI67, CENPF, TOP2A, CCNB1, AURKB, PLK1).
Recognized that the signature represents a proliferation state rather than a differentiated lineage.
weaknesses: Added unsupported 'neural progenitor' specificity based on tissue context (human cortex organoid) rather than ORIGINAL cluster markers.
No NPC-specific markers (e.g., PAX6, SOX2) present in the DEG list.

strengths: Captured the cycling/proliferative state of the cluster.
weaknesses: 'Progenitor cell' implies differentiation potential/lineage commitment that is not directly supported; all top DEGs are generic cell-cycle genes.
No progenitor-specific markers in the ORIGINAL evidence.

strengths: Identified the cycling component of the signature.
Attempted to connect the cycling state to a specific cell type.
weaknesses: B-cell identity is entirely unsupported: no B-lineage markers (CD19, MS4A1, CD79A/B) in the DEG list.
The enrichment terms are generic cell-cycle terms and cannot distinguish B cells from other cycling cells.

supporting: All 50 top DEGs are canonical cell-cycle/mitotic genes (MKI67, CENPF, TOP2A, CCNB1, CCNB2, CDK1, AURKB, PLK1, CDC20, UBE2C).
Enrichment terms are uniformly cell-cycle/mitotic: mitotic nuclear division, chromosome segregation, M Phase, Cell Cycle Checkpoints, hsa04110, hsa04114.
Absence of any lineage-specific markers in the DEG list supports a state-level 'cycling cell' identity.
conflicting: CASSIA 'neural progenitor' label lacks direct marker support and relies on tissue context.
In-house 'progenitor cell' label adds unsupported differentiation-potential component.
Enrichment 'cycling B cell' label lacks B-lineage marker support (no CD19/MS4A1/CD79A/B).
enrichment_or_literature: GO/Reactome/KEGG terms: nuclear division, chromosome segregation, mitotic cell cycle phase transition, spindle, condensed chromosome, hsa04110 (Cell cycle), hsa04114 (Oocyte meiosis).
